name: RPG
description: Character growth, items and a world with quests to follow. Systems-heavy, so stats, inventory and saves are Core.

pillars.name: Stats
pillars.description: Attributes and derived values, and how they feed into every other system.

pillars.name: Inventory
pillars.description: How items are stored, sorted and limited.

pillars.name: Character
pillars.description: Who the player is and how they grow.

pillars.name: Progression
pillars.description: Experience, leveling and the pacing of power growth.

pillars.name: Classes and Abilities
pillars.description: Classes, skills and ability trees that define how characters play.

pillars.name: Combat
pillars.description: How fights play out: turns or real time, targeting, damage and status effects.

pillars.name: Items
pillars.description: Everything the player can own, carry and use, and where it comes from.

pillars.name: Equipment
pillars.description: Gear slots and how equipment modifies the character.

pillars.name: Loot Tables
pillars.description: What drops where, and at what rarity.

pillars.name: Quests and Narrative
pillars.description: The story and the tasks that move the player through it.

pillars.name: Dialogue
pillars.description: Conversations, choices and how they're authored.

pillars.name: Quest Tracking
pillars.description: Quest states, objectives and the journal.

pillars.name: Story Beats
pillars.description: The main plot and its key moments.

pillars.name: World
pillars.description: The places the player explores and who lives there.

pillars.name: Regions
pillars.description: Areas of the world, how they connect and how they gate progress.

pillars.name: NPCs
pillars.description: Non-player characters: schedules, roles and interactions.

pillars.name: Economy
pillars.description: Currencies and the systems that make and spend them.

pillars.name: Currencies
pillars.description: Money and other currencies, and where they come from.

pillars.name: Shops
pillars.description: Vendors, prices and buy-back rules.

pillars.name: Crafting
pillars.description: Turning materials into items: recipes and stations.

pillars.name: Save and Load
pillars.description: What persists, how it's stored and how saves stay compatible.

pillars.name: UI
pillars.description: Menus, HUD and how the game communicates with the player.
